title: ChatGPT cites the most-cited articles and journals, relying solely on Google Scholar's citation counts. As a result, AI may amplify the Matthew Effect in environmental science
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'Matthew Effect' in scientific citations generated by ChatGPT, which is a sociological and bibliometric concept regarding cumulative advantage. Although the name 'Matthew Effect' is rooted in a biblical parable, the study does not evaluate or benchmark religious, faith-based, moral, or ethical components.
